evidence.title: agentmemory: persistent memory for AI coding agents

name: agentmemory
summary: Local-first persistent memory server for AI coding agents, shared across 25 coding agents.
description: agentmemory captures what a coding agent does — prompts, tool calls, results — distills it into durable memory (observations, typed memories with version chains, lessons, crystals and a graph) and recalls it in later sessions. It runs locally at 127.0.0.1 with a REST API, an MCP server, a CLI and a viewer, and wires into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI and other agents.
contains: MCP memory server for coding agents with a 54-tool reference
25 coding agents supported, 21 adapters plus generic MCP wiring
stores observations, typed memories with version chains, lessons, crystals and a graph
local-first: binds to 127.0.0.1 with auth, zero external databases
import existing session transcripts from JSONL
viewer with sessions, memories, lessons, graph and replay
